title: QBIND Public DevNet Full-Tree Package Integrity Manifest
description: Canonical, publish-safe schema for the FULL-TREE integrity manifest of the QBIND public DevNet release package under docs/release/public-devnet. Unlike the Run 404 anchor manifest (PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_MANIFEST.schema.json), which lists one VERIFY.md anchor per artifact group plus the top-level docs, this manifest lists EVERY regular publish-safe file in the package tree with its SHA-256 + byte size. It is GENERATED TRANSIENTLY at verification time into a temporary directory OUTSIDE the package tree and is NOT committed (the tree changes over time, so a committed full-tree manifest would immediately drift). Docs/artifact only: it embeds NO binary blob, NO secret, NO private path/hostname/endpoint, NO raw log, NO raw /metrics dump, and NO generated private identity. It is NOT binary provenance (see binary/RELEASE_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.schema.json for that) and it moves NO readiness item: M4 stays Yellow, M6 stays Yellow/Partial, S5/S7 stay Yellow, public DevNet stays NOT launch-ready, and C4/C5 stay OPEN.

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version (semver of this schema contract).

generated_for_run.description: The QBIND run number this manifest schema was introduced for. Fixed to 405.

scope.description: Stable scope tag for this manifest. Full documentation-package tree only.

coverage.description: Coverage discriminator distinguishing this from the anchor manifest. Fixed to full-tree.

safety_labels.description: Standing safety labels every artifact this manifest describes carries. All required labels must be present.

package_root.description: Repository-relative root of the documented public DevNet package. All file relative_path values are resolved against this root. Never an absolute path.

file_count.description: Exact number of entries in files[]. Must equal the length of files[]; a full-tree manifest lists every regular publish-safe file under package_root.

generated_at_utc.description: OPTIONAL UTC timestamp (ISO-8601, Zulu) when this manifest was generated. Informational only; the per-file SHA-256 + byte size are the authoritative integrity signal and do not depend on this field.

files.description: Every regular publish-safe package file under package_root, one entry each. Entries are minimal (relative_path + sha256 + byte_size) because the full tree is enumerated mechanically; per-group readiness/status labelling lives in the Run 404 anchor manifest and ARTIFACT_INDEX.md.

relative_path.description: Path of the file RELATIVE to package_root (docs/release/public-devnet). Forward-slash separated, never absolute, never containing '..', never a Windows drive path.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the on-disk file at package_root/relative_path.

byte_size.description: Exact byte size of the on-disk file.

non_claims.description: Explicit non-claim booleans. Every field must be exactly as fixed below (this manifest makes none of these claims).

artifact_safety_label.description: Standing human-readable safety label for every artifact this manifest describes.
artifact_safety_label.const: experimental · resettable · no value · no uptime SLA · NOT public-DevNet launch-ready · no MainNet readiness claim · no C4/C5 closure claim
